title: 第15章 西边捡来的项西(15)
slug: 格格不入全本免费-格格不入最新章节列表
content_zh:
程博衍速度很快，项西刚用胳膊护着脑袋探出半边身子，他已经绕到了副驾这边，两步跨过去一把抓住了那人正拿着钢管要往下砸的手。
项西趁机跳下车，拿车门往那人身上用力撞了一下。
正琢磨着该怎么收拾这人的时候，项西听到他惨叫了一声。
这惨叫把项西吓了一跳，转脸一瞅，看到这人的胳膊已经被程博衍拧到了背后，他刚要叫好，听到钢管掉地的声音，赶紧冲过去捡了起来。
这人一脸狰狞地挣扎着，项西盯着他的脸看了看，路上闲逛的时候要注意躲开的人除了警察，别的项西基本都认识，但这人真不太有印象。
只能凭借他有些歪的嘴判断可能是驴脸的人，但现在也不知道嘴本来是歪的还是这表情拧的。
靠近他时项西闻到了酒臭，喝多了撒酒疯的吗！
歪嘴块头挺大，不干不净地骂着，挣扎得很凶，程博衍正想把他推开的时候，他侧过身往后抡了一拳：“老子废了你。”
程博衍没提防，被他一拳砸在了眼角，皱了皱眉。
“你废谁啊！”项西对着他脸上砸了一拳。
抬腿打算再踹一脚的时候，歪嘴又一声惨叫，这声比之前那声惨多了，听得项西都想跟他一块儿哭了。
程博衍松开歪嘴的时候，项西发现歪嘴的右膀子抬不起来了，整条垂着，弯着腰靠在路边的栏杆上喊着。
“他膀子被你卸了？”项西从小到大打架、被打、看人打无数次，这么干净利索迅速地就把人膀子给卸了的还是头一回见，顿时有些兴奋。
程博衍没理他，拍了拍裤子上的灰，转身上了车。
“哎，哥！”项西往歪嘴屁股上蹬了一脚，一拉车门跟着也上了车，“你厉害啊！骨科医生就是不一样啊，卸得真专业……”
“下去。”程博衍看着他。
“哥，程大夫，”项西笑了笑，“别生气啊，你听……你脸破了……”
“下去，”程博衍按了一下喇叭，“怎么？你还等我送你回去？”
“……你车窗砸坏了啊，”项西对他的态度并不在意，指了指车窗，“你刚才说八百，是换玻璃的价钱吧？”
“不用了，我赶时间，”程博衍看了看手机上的时间，“你该干吗干吗去，碰瓷给你爹治病去吧。”

项西没说话，脸上的笑容也消失了，沉默了一会儿他下了车，转身冲车里说了一句：“车窗我会赔你的。”
程博衍发动了车子，项西把车门甩上了，嘭的一声。
看着他飞快地消失在前面的拐角，程博衍皱着眉叹了口气，抽了纸巾往眼角按了按，破了道小口子，有点儿出血。
他扫了一眼还抱着肩靠坐在树下的人，回手拿过车上的急救药，“别动，”他蹲到那人身边，抓住了他的手腕，“放松，疼就忍着点儿。”
那人一动不动地瞪着他，似乎还没回过神来。
程博衍一手托着他的胳膊肘，把他的手臂弯了起来，慢慢牵引着往外展，再把上臂也往外转，接着再把肘部往胸口那边推过去，最后上臂往里一旋，那人的肩膀响了一声。
“行了。”程博衍拿过三角巾，很快地把他的胳膊肘固定在了胸前，然后转身上了车。
“你是医生啊？”那人这会儿才缓过劲，站起来喊了一嗓子。
程博衍没理他，开了车走了。
今天晚上他值班，提前了一小时出门，本来想着顺路买了菜还能有时间，可以再去给老妈买部手机，答应了送老妈一部手机，从年前到现在，快半个月了一直都没买。
现在这么一折腾，又买不成了。
他从后视镜里看了看自己的脸，伤口不大，贴块创可贴就行。
展宏图眼角下贴着创可贴的脸从他眼前晃过，他顿时有点儿上火。
他居然相信了这小子之前说的那些话！
什么胃里长了瘤子的爹！什么为了给爹治病出来趴活儿！什么被债主追着打！什么骨折了为了照顾爹不能住院！
那么情真意切、可怜巴巴的！演技简直炉火纯青得能练出一炉长生不老丹！
程博衍都想跟他说你赶紧趴活儿攒点儿钱报个表演班将来肯定能在演艺圈里大展宏图。
一直到了医院程博衍的脸色都不怎么好看，碰到护士小江的时候，小姑娘瞪着他看了半天才小心地问了一句：“程大夫，你脸上……是碰的还是有人闹事啊？”

content_en:
Cheng Boyan was very fast, and Xiang west just leaned out half of his body with his arm to protect his head. He had already walked around to the passenger side, stepped over in two steps and grabbed the man's hand that was holding the steel pipe to smash down.
Xiang west took the opportunity to jump out of the car and hit the man hard with the car door.
Just when he was thinking about how to deal with this man, Xiang west heard him scream.
The scream startled Xiang Xi. He turned around and saw that the man's arm had been twisted behind his back by Cheng Boyan. He was about to shout when he heard the sound of the steel pipe falling to the ground and rushed over to pick it up.
This man was struggling with a ferocious look on his face. Xiang west stared at his face. Apart from the police, Xiang Xi basically knew the people he should avoid when wandering on the road, but he really didn't have much impression of this man.
We can only judge that he may have a donkey face based on his slightly crooked mouth, but now we don't know whether his mouth is crooked in the first place or because of this expression.
Xiang west smelled the smell of wine when he got close to him. Are you crazy after drinking too much?
Waizui was quite big, and he was cursing obscenely and struggling fiercely. When Cheng Boyan was trying to push him away, he turned sideways and punched back: "I will destroy you."
Cheng Boyan didn't take precautions and was punched in the corner of his eye, and he frowned.
"Who are you trying to destroy!" Xiang west punched him in the face.
When he raised his leg to kick him again, Waizui let out another scream. This one was much worse than the previous one. Hearing it, Xiang Xi wanted to cry with him.
When Cheng Boyan let go of Waizui, Xiang west found that Waizui's right arm could no longer be lifted. It was hanging down and he was bent over and leaning on the railing on the side of the road, shouting.
"Did you take off his arm?" Xiang Xi had fought, been beaten, and watched people beat him countless times since he was a child. This was the first time he had removed someone's arm so cleanly and quickly, and he was suddenly excited.
Cheng Boyan ignored him, patted the dust on his pants, turned around and got in the car.
"Hey, brother!" Xiang Xi kicked Waizui's butt, pulled the car door and got in the car, "You are amazing! Orthopedic surgeons are different, they are so professional in unloading..."
"Go down." Cheng Boyan looked at him.
"Brother, Doctor Cheng," Xiang Xi smiled, "Don't be angry, listen... you are embarrassed..."
"Go down," Cheng Boyan honked the horn, "What? Are you still waiting for me to take you back?"
"...Your car window is broken," Xiang west didn't care about his attitude and pointed to the car window, "You just said eight hundred, is it the price of replacing the glass?"
"No, I'm in a hurry," Cheng Boyan looked at the time on his phone, "Go and do whatever you need to do. Go and treat your father."
Xiang Xi didn't speak, and the smile on his face disappeared. After a moment of silence, he got out of the car, turned around and said to the car: "I will pay you for the car window."
Cheng Boyan started the car and Xiang west opened the car door with a bang.
Watching him disappear quickly around the corner in front, Cheng Boyan frowned and sighed, took out a tissue and pressed it to the corner of his eye, making a small cut and bleeding a little.
He glanced at the man who was still hugging his shoulder and sitting under the tree, and reached back to take the first aid medicine in the car. "Don't move," he squatted next to the man and grabbed his wrist, "Relax, just endure the pain."
The man stared at him motionless, as if he hadn't recovered yet.
Cheng Boyan held his elbow with one hand, bent his arm, slowly pulled it outward, then turned his upper arm outward, then pushed his elbow toward his chest, and finally turned his upper arm inward, and the man's shoulder made a sound.
"Okay." Cheng Boyan took the triangle scarf, quickly fixed his elbow on his chest, then turned around and got into the car.
"Are you a doctor?" The man finally regained his composure and stood up and shouted.
Cheng Boyan ignored him and drove away.
He was on duty tonight and left the house an hour early. He originally thought that he would have some time to buy groceries on the way, so he could go and give some food to him.When my mother bought a mobile phone, she promised to give her a mobile phone. From two years ago to now, it has been almost half a month since she bought one.
Now after all this trouble, I can't buy it anymore.
He looked at his face in the rearview mirror. The wound was not big, just a Band-Aid would do.
Zhan Hongtu's face with a band-aid on it flashed past his eyes, and he suddenly got a little angry.
He actually believed what this kid said before!
What kind of father has a tumor in his stomach? Why do you go out to work just to treat your father? Why are you being chased and beaten by creditors! Why is he broken and can't be hospitalized just to take care of his father?
So sincere and pitiful! His acting skills are so perfect that he can make an elixir of immortality!
Cheng Boyan wanted to tell him that you should work hard and save some money to sign up for an acting class. You will definitely be able to make a big splash in the entertainment industry in the future.
Cheng Boyan's face didn't look very good until he arrived at the hospital. When he met the nurse Xiao Jiang, the little girl stared at him for a long time before asking cautiously: "Doctor Cheng, did you touch... on your face or was someone causing trouble?"
